name: while-stmt-test-8fe83cda27/while-stmt-infinite-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions lists "Start action" and "Wait action", but does not list named worker declarations.
reason: The whole case includes a named worker declaration (worker name returns int) containing an infinite loop and returning its worker future. Named worker declarations are not covered by the supported feature lists; supported start/wait actions do not establish named worker support. This is decisive even though ordinary while loops and anonymous functions are supported.
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: ordinary, nested, conditional and anonymous-function infinite loops are combined with a named worker and client class methods.
main is empty and there are no @args, @panic or @output markers; the file exercises compilation/return-flow acceptance rather than executing or asserting infinite-loop runtime behavior.
